description: Demonstrate the next new domain by composing workforce quotations and laboratory recipes into a versioned newborn-screening programme model, with conserved shared costs and explicit denominators.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/microcosting_healthworkforce and edithatogo/microcosting_genomics: qualified quotation and laboratory-recipe providers.
Jurisdiction/programme source owner: actual screening scope, clinical pathway, probabilities, timing, quantities and rates; no default clinical assumptions are supplied.
edithatogo/UOGTO and edithatogo/standards_check: diagnostic and general costing reporting profiles.

verification.scope: Two-infant event/process/object fixture produces150total and60/90views through the shared core. Full recipe branches, denominators and real programme qualification remain open.

completion_evidence: The synthetic two-infant fixture conserves a 150 total: collections 10 each, one batch 100 allocated 50/50 and confirmation 30 for infant B; infant views are 60 and 90.
Collection, transport, setup, controls and batch resources are counted once; allocation views do not add another expense.
Repeat specimens/tests alter appropriate quantities without inflating the distinct-infant denominator.
Cost per eligible birth, participating infant, valid screen, completed pathway and confirmed diagnosis have explicit denominator/window identities.
Clinical probabilities, timing, assay scope and rates are versioned programme inputs; no synthetic fixture is presented as clinical evidence.

When reporting support is advertised, applicable CHEERS/GHCC/AGREEDT coverage includes evidence and exclusions through the qualified optional profile adapter; lifetime outcomes remain the linked model owner's responsibility.
